topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the multidisciplinary learning objectives, and sets out the scope of cancer biology.

topics.label: Genetic and Developmental Foundations of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer as a stepwise breakdown of normal genetic regulation and developmental tissue differentiation and consider the laboratory approaches used to study these cellular changes.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion, Metastasis, and Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the clinical and histological progression of tumors from localized, benign states to invasive and metastatic malignancies.

topics.label: Tumor Nomenclature and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the systematic naming conventions and exceptions used to classify benign and malignant tumors across different tissue origins.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical, functional, and systemic mechanisms through which primary and metastatic tumors cause clinical illness and death.

topics.label: Comparative Incidence of Tumors Across Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the incidence and prevalence of various benign and malignant tumor types in humans and across other multicellular animal species.

topics.label: Clinical Detection and Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the rationale for early tumor detection and evaluate the implementation and effectiveness of screening programs across different cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture by revisiting the learning outcomes and providing logistical instructions for upcoming practicals and sessions.
